runtime: Native static binary built with Cargo
ui: Leptos or HTMX only if a UI is in scope
http: axum + tower with typed extractors and explicit error types
db: PostgreSQL + sqlx (compile-time checked, forward-only SQL migrations)
validation: serde + newtype boundary parsing (reject invalid states at deserialisation)
tests: cargo test for unit and integration tests under tests/
logs: tracing with structured span correlation IDs
